image_description: A group of four people posing for a portrait, wearing black academic regalia (gowns, mortarboards/caps). The subjects are arranged in two rows. The person in the front right holds a diploma scroll. The person in the front left holds a white cane or staff. The background is a warm, textured studio backdrop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/thigh level; the 'ankles' and full length are not visible. Additionally, the gowns appear somewhat fitted rather than strictly rectangular due to the pose.
The gowns on the visible subjects (especially front right) show a clear center-front vertical line/opening and general bilateral symmetry in the sleeve placement.
The fabric drapes loosely, hiding the specific shape of the torso and legs, consistent with academic robes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject in the front right clearly displays the characteristic wide, bell-shaped sleeve hanging down past the wrist/hand holding the diploma.
Vertical panels are visible along the front opening of the gowns.
Collared shirts and ties are visible at the necklines of the subjects.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears dark, opaque, and has a low-sheen matte finish consistent with polyester blends used for regalia.
No specular highlights or glossy reflections are observed on the gown surfaces.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Confirmed on the front-right subject; the sleeve cuff hangs significantly lower than the hand.

artifact_observations.location: Hands of front-left subject holding white staff
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers merging with the white staff are indistinct and malformed. The grip lacks anatomical definition, appearing as a fused blob of skin tone and white pixels.
The facial features are overly smooth and lack pore detail compared to the front subjects, resembling a 'waxy' AI-generated texture. The eyes appear slightly asymmetrical.

The geometry of the caps is inconsistent. The cap on the front-right subject has a tassel that seems to float without a clear attachment point, and the board itself lacks rigid straight-line perspective.

artifact_observations.location: Shoulder area between front-left and back-left subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is slight bleeding/fusion where the black gown of the front subject meets the shoulder of the subject behind them, making the boundary ambiguous.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of regalia (e.g., doctoral vs. bachelor's) and confirm class alignment.
To audit the structural integrity of hands and arms, specifically checking for the finger fusion artifacts observed.
To check for edge bleeding between the black gowns and the background/other subjects, and to verify the cap geometry.
To assess the severity of the waxy facial textures and hand deformities.

focus_areas: Hand anatomy and object interaction (holding staff/diploma)
Facial texture consistency across all subjects
Boundary sharpness between overlapping black garments
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands holding objects. AI often fails at rendering fingers gripping cylindrical items like the staff or scroll. Also, verify if the 'waxy' look on the background faces is a compression artifact or a generative failure. Check if the cap tassels have valid physical attachment points.
